name: Mutsuki Kana
source:
A student in Yuuichi's cram school. 
Is very friendly to Yuuichi, helps him a lot, and often visits for food. 
She owns Kuu, an exceptionally intelligent anthropoid cat.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanko_to_Kurasō]Wikipedia[/url]]
